title: Théorie des cycles algébriques : conjectures de Hodge, Tate, Lefschetz, Weil : notes manuscrites (s.d.), lettre (1965).

deep.reconstruction:
Title: 'Relations entre hom[omorphismes] de V[ariétés] A[béliennes] et groupes de N[éron]-S[everi]'. The page relates divisors on an abelian variety A (dim n, dual A*) to homomorphisms A→A*, and compatibly to l-adic cohomology.

(1) Top square.
- Left vertical: C^1(A) → Hom(A,A*), D ↦ φ_D = Λ(O(D)), x ↦ t_x^*D − D.
- Top horizontal: the cycle class C^1(A) → H^2(A)⊗Q_l(1) = Λ^2 H^1(A)⊗Q_l(1).
- Right vertical: the duality given by the pairing H^1(A)×H^1(A*) → Q_l(±1), which is the Weil pairing / Poincaré bundle. It identifies Λ^2 H^1(A)(1) with the alternating maps H^1(A*) → H^1(A), with suitable twist.
- Bottom horizontal: Hom(A,A*) → Hom(H^1(A*),H^1(A)), u ↦ u^* = H^1(u).
Commutativity of this square is the classical statement that the class of D in Λ^2 V_l^∨(1) is the Riemann form e^{φ_D}, up to sign or factor.

(2) Graph map. Hom(A,A*) → C^n(A×A*) sends u to its graph Γ_u. Grothendieck notes explicitly that this is not additive. The cohomological counterpart is Hom(H^1(A*),H^1(A)) → H^{2n}(A×A*)(n).

(3) Verification via ū = (id_A,u): A → A×A*.
- The graph class is ū_*(1) ∈ H^{2n}(A×A*)(n).
- It is characterised by the projection formula: ū_* on H^0 is paired against ū^* on H^{2n}, with H^{2n}(A) ≅ Q_l(−n).
- On H^1, ū^* is (id_{H^1(A)}, u^1) on H^1(A×A*) = H^1(A)⊕H^1(A*).
So the Künneth (1,2n−1)-component of cl(Γ_u) recovers u^1 = H^1(u), even though the full class is not additive in u.

Purpose: set up the comparison between NS(A)⊗Q_l and Hom(A,A*)⊗Q_l (symmetric part) inside cohomology. This is the standard step reducing Tate (and Hodge/Lefschetz-type) statements for divisors on abelian varieties to statements about homomorphisms, i.e. Tate's isogeny theorem. This context fits cote 14 (Hodge, Tate, Lefschetz, Weil conjectures).
errors: The Tate twist in the pairing H^1(A)×H^1(A*) → Q_l(1) is probably off by sign. The natural cup/Poincaré-bundle pairing takes values in Q_l(−1) (dual to the Weil pairing V_lA×V_lA* → Q_l(1)); harmless at this sketch level.
Commutativity of the top square only holds up to a sign/normalisation convention for the Riemann form; not addressed (sketch).
The diagram is unfinished: the right diagonal arrow Hom(H^1(A*),H^1(A)) → H^{2n}(A×A*)(n) is not defined precisely, and the computation of ū_*(1) stops.

ideas.what: Divisor ↦ homomorphism φ_D: NS(A) ≅ symmetric Hom(A,A*), compatible with the l-adic cycle class into Λ^2H^1(1)
ideas.modern_name: Néron–Severi group as symmetric homomorphisms; Riemann form of a line bundle

ideas.what: Tate conjecture for divisors on A reduced to the isogeny statement via this square
ideas.modern_name: Tate's theorem on endomorphisms of abelian varieties / Tate conjecture for divisors on abelian varieties

ideas.what: Graph of a homomorphism as an n-cycle on A×A*, non-additive, whose Künneth (1,2n−1) component is additive and equals H^1(u)
ideas.modern_name: Cycle class of graph / Künneth components of correspondences

deep.surprise_reason: A standard, unfinished sketch of the classical compatibility between NS(A), Hom(A,A*) and l-adic H^1/H^2 (Weil/Tate). The remark that the graph map is non-additive is correct but well known. Nothing absent from the literature.
transcription_corrections: The second diagram line should read Hom(A, A*) → Hom(H^1(A*), H^1(A)), with the right vertical labelled 'dualité de l'accouplement H^1(A)×H^1(A*) → Q_l(1)'.
The diagonal label reads 'utilisation "graphe" (pas additive!)', with 'utilisation' partly struck; plausibly the struck word is an alternative reading.
The struck-out symbol under H^*(A) ← H^*(A×A*) is a crossed-out 'ū^*'.
The bottom map on H^1 is (id_{H^1(A)}, u^1); here H^1(A×A*) = H^1(A)⊕H^1(A*) (written × in the manuscript).
